missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Зал' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Этот' points at a specific hall, and 'большой' is the predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Зал' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'украсили'. 'К празднику' is the dative of purpose.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В зале' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to locate the concert. 'Большом' agrees in the masculine prepositional case.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В зал' uses the accusative after 'в' to show motion into the hall. 'Зрители' is the nominative subject, and 'тихо' is the adverb.
Strategic focus: Genitive after из. 'Зала' is the genitive after 'из' showing motion out of the hall. 'Гости' is the nominative subject, and 'все' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Залу' is the dative after 'к' showing approach toward the hall. 'Главному' agrees in the masculine dative, and 'идут' is the verb of motion.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after перед. 'Залом' is the instrumental after 'перед' showing position in front of the hall. 'Очередь' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after несколько. 'Залов' is the genitive plural required by the quantity word 'несколько'. 'Красивых' agrees in the plural, and 'в театре' locates them.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Залы' is the nominative plural and the subject. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'полны людей' uses a genitive complement.

missions.phrase: Мы прошли по всем залам музея.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative plural after по. 'Залам' is the dative plural after 'по' showing movement through the halls. 'Всем' agrees in the plural, and 'музея' is the genitive possessor.
